description.value: Municipal campground along the Kettle River in the heart of downtown Grand Forks, within easy walking distance of grocery stores, restaurants, and services; open May 1–October 15 with a resident host and online reservations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is a municipal campground along the Kettle River in downtown Grand Forks, with RV and tenting sites (capacity 40 per OSM). Address (7162 5th Street) and phone (250-442-2211) are corroborated by the website. Website explicitly mentions nearby grocery stores and restaurants within walking distance, confirming food nearby. Reservations confirmed via prominent 'BOOK NOW' button and detailed reservation policy. OSM tags indicate free WiFi and power supply, but the website does not specifically mention these amenities, so WiFi is not independently confirmed and power_supply likely refers to RV hookups rather than cyclist device charging.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Municipal campground with tenting sites in a walkable downtown location along the Kettle River, well-suited for touring cyclists on the Boundary region routes.
